thought.text: Media round-trip through the Matrix API works (upload returned `mxc://` URI, download returned the 67-byte PNG). The `mc ls` "Access Denied" with app credentials is just the least-privilege IAM policy (object-level grants, no ListBucket) — expected, since the Matrix API media path is the functional test and it passed. The admin dashboard loads after SSO. Let me do a final consolidated check and clean up my scratch files.

reasoning_content:
The app credentials can't list the nebu-media bucket (Access Denied), but the media upload via the Matrix API succeeded and returned an mxc URI, and the download also succeeded (round-trip verified). This confirms that the media storage pipeline is working end-to-end through the Matrix API. The fact that `mc ls` with the app credentials can't list is simply a matter of the IAM policy — the app's policy is likely restricted to specific object-level operations (put/get on a prefix) rather than ListBucket, which is a normal least-privilege configuration. The createbuckets container has already successfully created the bucket, IAM user, and policy (exit 0). So MinIO is up and running. The upload/download round-trip through the Matrix API is the true functional test, and it passed.

The admin dashboard is accessible with the session after SSO login.

Let me do the final cleanup and confirm everything is consistent. I'll clean up the temporary verification files and summarize. Actually, the files under /tmp/nebu-validate are just my own working files — I should delete them, but they're in /tmp and harmless. Let me delete them for tidiness.

No wait, let me reconsider whether I should delete them. The verification files I created are under /tmp/nebu-validate. They're temporary working files. Let me delete them for tidiness. However, the session artifacts under /tmp/nebu-bootstrap are from the original install attempt and I should leave them alone (they're not mine). Let me only delete my own directory.

Let me do the final comprehensive check and clean up my own temporary files.

action.command:
echo "=== FINAL: container health ==="
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}' | sort
echo
echo "=== FINAL: key endpoints ==="
printf 'Matrix /health (8008):      '; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8008/health
printf 'Matrix versions (8008):     '; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/versions
printf 'Admin login (8080):         '; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/admin/login
printf 'Dex (5556):                 '; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:5556/dex
printf 'MinIO console (9001):       '; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:9001/
printf 'MinIO S3 live (9000):       '; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live
echo
echo "=== bootstrap lock state (unauth redirects) ==="
printf '/admin/dashboard unauth -> '; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}\n' http://localhost:8080/admin/dashboard
printf '/admin/bootstrap unauth -> '; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}\n' http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap
echo
echo "=== cleanup my scratch ==="
rm -rf /tmp/nebu-validate && echo "removed /tmp/nebu-validate"
